units.english: The largest of Korath production vessels are derived from a common and ancient chassis, including this large Efreti vessel. Facing very different challenges, and taking some inspiration from their Quarg protectors, the Efreti descendant of the "World-Ships" of old is lighter, faster, and more efficient, but less powerful than its Exile counterparts.
units.raw: description `The largest of Korath production vessels are derived from a common and ancient chassis, including this large Efreti vessel. Facing very different challenges, and taking some inspiration from their Quarg protectors, the Efreti descendant of the "World-Ships" of old is lighter, faster, and more efficient, but less powerful than its Exile counterparts.`

units.english: Although they do not effectively provide for their own defense, the Efreti remain responsible for the day-to-day needs of civilian and cargo transportation. While not as bulky or powerful as other Korath designs, this freighter is much faster at making runs back and forth between the Efreti's handful of remaining planets, while still holding enough defensive loadout to ward off the odd Mereti drone that slips past the Quarg.
units.raw: description "Although they do not effectively provide for their own defense, the Efreti remain responsible for the day-to-day needs of civilian and cargo transportation. While not as bulky or powerful as other Korath designs, this freighter is much faster at making runs back and forth between the Efreti's handful of remaining planets, while still holding enough defensive loadout to ward off the odd Mereti drone that slips past the Quarg."

units.english: A recent design, this Efreti multi-role vessel is found taking up many jobs previously relegated to a now scrapped fleet of early-model raiders. While some are used primarily for passenger transport, others are used in local mining to satiate the Efreti's perpetual demand for ores. Incorporating Quarg-inspired structural elements, its light frame allows it to complete tasks more nimbly than any other independent Korath ship.

units.english: The largest and deadliest of the Kor Sestor robotic warships, a single one of these battlecruisers can hold its own against an entire fleet of lesser ships.
units.raw: description "The largest and deadliest of the Kor Sestor robotic warships, a single one of these battlecruisers can hold its own against an entire fleet of lesser ships."

units.english: The Kor Sestor war fleets rely heavily on small, powerful fighters and drones. This ship can carry up to ten of their drones, clamped to the exterior of its hull.
units.raw: description "The Kor Sestor war fleets rely heavily on small, powerful fighters and drones. This ship can carry up to ten of their drones, clamped to the exterior of its hull."

units.english: This carrier is equipped with docking clamps for up to nine fighters. When loaded with a full complement of the powerful Kor Sestor robotic fighters, it is a formidable opponent.
units.raw: description "This carrier is equipped with docking clamps for up to nine fighters. When loaded with a full complement of the powerful Kor Sestor robotic fighters, it is a formidable opponent."

units.english: The TF109 is designed almost solely for the purpose of carrying a fleet of Kor Sestor fighters and drones. Without them to serve as a protective screen, the ship itself is relatively helpless.
units.raw: description "The TF109 is designed almost solely for the purpose of carrying a fleet of Kor Sestor fighters and drones. Without them to serve as a protective screen, the ship itself is relatively helpless."

units.english: Although this is the smallest Kor Sestor ship other than their fighters, it is larger than most human capital ships and considerably more powerful.
units.raw: description "Although this is the smallest Kor Sestor ship other than their fighters, it is larger than most human capital ships and considerably more powerful."

units.english: At the peak of their recent civil war, the Kor Sestor faction developed these automated attack drones, easy to manufacture and encased in an ultra-dense hull that can absorb a significant amount of damage.
units.raw: description "At the peak of their recent civil war, the Kor Sestor faction developed these automated attack drones, easy to manufacture and encased in an ultra-dense hull that can absorb a significant amount of damage."

units.english: Drones do not come equipped with a hyperdrive. You cannot carry a drone unless you have a ship in your fleet with a drone bay.
units.raw: description "	Drones do not come equipped with a hyperdrive. You cannot carry a drone unless you have a ship in your fleet with a drone bay."

units.english: Because it is piloted by a computer and has no need for a cockpit or life support systems, the FS27 fighter is able to support a thicker hull, more shields, and more powerful guns than any comparable human ship.
units.raw: description "Because it is piloted by a computer and has no need for a cockpit or life support systems, the FS27 fighter is able to support a thicker hull, more shields, and more powerful guns than any comparable human ship."

units.english: Fighters do not come equipped with a hyperdrive. You cannot carry a fighter unless you have a ship in your fleet with a fighter bay.
